28gt:
The University of Gloucestershire's Bachelor of Arts in Business and Management scored 94% for teaching in the National Student Survey 2023.

Students in their first year will gain solid grounding in all aspects of business and management. In their second and third year, they will continue to develop knowledge and expertise in business and management but also choose a specialist career path.

Graduates will develop their live project management skills exploring alternative approaches to planning, execution, and operations, and learn how project management success can be judged. The University will also challenge them to stretch their global commercial awareness with an international focus on business.

28h9:
The Bachelor of Arts in International Business Management will help students become a business leader in the global market. They will study business on an international scale, covering areas such as how to manage operations globally and cultural issues in management, perfectly preparing them for an international career.

Graduates will develop skills in managing people, projects, finance, Human Resource, marketing and logistics across different cultures and environments. They will understand the global economy and explore global sustainability issues and ethics.

28ev:
Students will learn all the skills needed to become a multimedia journalist, from creating exciting content for social media and podcasts to broadcasting live from the University of Gloucestershire's industry-standard newsrooms in the Bachelor of Arts in Journalism. The University will turbo-charge their confidence so they embrace the University's ‘say yes to everything’ mantra and do things they never thought possible.

Graduates will put new skills into practice every day on a hands-on course where they will never be just a number. They will be taught in small groups where they will very much be part of a community.

The University's accreditation from Britain’s biggest journalism training organization, the National Council for the Training of Journalists, means they can be sure that the skills they are developing are the ones that employers prize. They will have their own exclusive industry mentor in the final year, and the chance to go on placements at the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), commercial radio stations and major regional news brands such as Reach and Newsquest.
28i7:
Students will explore the fundamental principles of law in England and Wales on a Bachelor of Law designed to enable prospective lawyers to obtain the legal knowledge, skills and attributes needed to pursue a career in law, aligned with professional standards.

Graduates will take part in engaging and stimulating teaching through the University of Gloucestershire interactive and challenging teaching sessions. They will obtain knowledge and skills in key areas of the Law of England and Wales as well as gaining an insight into international law. Students can also specialize in a range of subjects including family law, company law, intellectual property law and human rights depending on their area of interest.

28go:
Students will become a well-rounded professional understanding both the operations of a business and the finances behind it with Bachelor of Arts in Accounting and Business Management. They can put their skills to the test and enter the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA).

Graduates will work from the University of Gloucestershire's state-of-the-art Oxstalls Campus in Gloucester. The 18 million development is home to the Business, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Law and Accounting and Finance courses.

Students will learn through lectures, seminars, group work, reflective practice, business simulations, problem-solving challenges and presenting. Real world case studies offer them the opportunity to build their expertise while simulations and live pitches give them practical experience. They will have opportunities to work with leading businesses and be able to complete a work placement as part of their degree. This will prepare learners to graduate career-ready.
89dg:
The Professional Master’s by Research in Education adopts an active learning approach with a strong emphasis on real-world application, offering a practical and professionally oriented course tailored for international students. The programme encourages interactive learning through discussions, case studies, guest lectures, and collaborative projects, fostering meaningful engagement between students and lecturers, as well as among peers. Designed to be inclusive, the course promotes integration and collaboration among students from diverse cultural and academic backgrounds.

A distinctive feature of the programme is its strong focus on empirical research. Students are given the opportunity to undertake a research project that critically applies educational theories to real-world challenges. This experience enhances their knowledge and understanding while strengthening critical and analytical thinking skills essential for a global career in education.

While lectures and seminars form part of the teaching approach, students are encouraged to engage in small communities of practice—collaborative peer groups based on shared research interests or methodologies. Peer review and constructive feedback are integrated into the learning process to support the development of reflective listening, critical evaluation, and a commitment to action.

The programme promotes the use of technology in learning to maximise engagement, build transferable skills, and enrich the overall educational experience. A ‘bring your own device’ policy encourages students to develop digital literacies, contributing to innovative learning design and dynamic learning activities.

The course experience is further enhanced through live briefs, real-world case studies, staff-led research initiatives, guest speakers, and strong links to industry. These elements provide students with direct pathways to future career opportunities and ensure a rich and applied learning journey.
898f:
This professional MA by Research is designed with an active learning approach that emphasises real-world application, creating a practical and industry-focused experience for both international and home students. Teaching is delivered through expert-led lectures, alongside collaborative activities such as group discussions, debates, role play, and professional briefs. The course fosters an inclusive environment that encourages integration and collaboration among students from diverse backgrounds.

Students develop the knowledge, skills, and professional networks needed to pursue a career in Public Relations and communications. The curriculum covers key areas including influencer targeting, social media strategy, campaign planning, crisis communications, media relations, and strategic communications. Practical skills are also developed in video and podcast production, copywriting, and editing using Adobe software, alongside learning the latest digital PR techniques and the evolving role of AI in content creation and the wider PR industry.

The teaching team includes practising PR professionals, supported by guest speakers from leading organisations, offering valuable industry insight and networking opportunities. The study approach combines lectures and seminars with small peer learning communities, where students engage in shared research interests and approaches. Peer review and feedback play a key role in developing critical thinking, reflective listening, and evaluative skills.

A strong emphasis is placed on empirical research, culminating in an independent research project that applies theory to real-world challenges. This enables students to deepen their analytical abilities and operate effectively within a global context. Technology is integrated throughout the course to enhance engagement and build transferable skills.

The programme is enriched through live briefs, real-world case studies, staff research, and industry connections. Students build a professional portfolio that includes communication strategies and multimedia content, supporting their transition into employment. Guest speakers have included organisations such as Sport England, UCAS, BHM, Reach Plc, and various PR agencies.

Prospective students should be aware that this research degree requires a high level of academic commitment throughout its duration. Those planning to bring dependents are advised to carefully consider their arrangements to ensure their studies are not adversely affected.
7dyz:
Research a topic of your choice or work on an extended creative project. Boost your professional practice and develop high-level skills and knowledge to progress your career.

You’ll benefit from an experienced team of research-active scholars and industry practitioners who can offer supervision across a range of topics. Staff specialisms include:

  • cult film and TV
  • documentary film
  • screenwriting
  • experimental cinema
  • digital archives
  • digital storytelling
28ie:
Social workers support and empower individuals to make positive changes and improve their lives. They work to protect vulnerable people while respecting and promoting human rights. Upon successful completion of this intensive Master’s route, graduates will be eligible to apply for registration as a registered Social Worker with Social Work England.

The teaching staff are registered social work practitioners, bringing specific areas of knowledge and expertise to the programme. Successful completion of this programme will allow graduates to apply for registration with Social Work England. Once registered, they can choose to practice in their preferred field, whether in children and families or adults, and across a wide range of areas within statutory, voluntary, private, and independent sectors.

The teaching programme is dynamic, interactive, and experiential. Through academic and applied learning, this programme provides a balance of theoretical frameworks and interactive practical work experiences in social work and social care settings.

Students will engage in studies that equip them with the necessary knowledge, skills, and theoretical frameworks that inform all areas of social work practice with adults and children.

With an emphasis on experiential learning, the programme includes working in small tutorial and seminar groups, simulations, role play, group work, and opportunities to develop reflective and critical debate.
28g0:
The Master of Design in Graphic Design course gives students the opportunity to extend their portfolio and move creative work into new spaces and career directions.

Graduates will be challenged to build upon their communication and design research skills and apply these to successful problem-solving at a master’s level. They will explore contemporary issues in graphic design whilst gaining insights into global trends and dialogues in design by crossing genres and disciplines.

The University of Gloucestershire have recently developed a partnership with Cheltenham Borough Council’s climate emergency team, students work on live briefs that support the research and communication of the projects.
947b:
The Master of Business Administration (Top-up) is designed for individuals with prior business experience as well as specialists seeking progression into senior management roles. It provides an opportunity to engage with business issues at a more fundamental and strategic level.

The programme is also suitable for recent graduates aiming to enhance their employability. Regardless of prior experience, the MBA (Master’s Stage Award) offers a flexible study route that enables students to refresh and develop their management skills and knowledge. Students also have the opportunity to gain professional accreditation from the Chartered Management Institute (CMI).

Throughout the programme, students examine evolving areas of strategy, leadership, and management theory and practice, and develop the ability to apply this knowledge confidently within practical organisational contexts.
5dot:
The Master of Business Administration in Global Business Administration will provide students with the knowledge foundations of business before offering the unique opportunity to specialize in their chosen industrial field, allowing the flexibility to shape study based on their career aspirations. It is designed to develop creative, flexible and aspirational leaders of industry.

Learners will be immersed in fundamental business principles. These core foundations of business integrate cross-cutting themes relating to the global challenges shaping today’s business environment, including technological change, the global political and economic context, social and demographic change and environmental crisis.

The programs are supported by the University's Global Leadership development program and 12 month industry placement, they will be offered the opportunity to develop the most in-demand skills needed to confront the challenges and unlock the opportunities of a dynamic and unpredictable economic environment.

It is designed to develop creative, flexible and aspirational leaders of industry.
